scope: Correct existing exact lexical displays with fresh fingerprinted scope; preserve raw dictionaries and learner histories.

explanation.en: 团长 refers to the person who commands a regiment. It names the commander, rather than the abstract activity or authority of command.
explanation.zh: “团长”指指挥一个团的人，表示担任这一职务的人，而不是抽象的指挥活动或指挥权。

lexical_uses.context: Naming the commander of a regiment.

explanation.en: 依法 means in accordance with law. Place it before the action carried out under the law. It does not mean an attributive legal describing a question or proceeding.
explanation.zh: “依法”表示按照法律办事，放在所进行的动作前。它不是用来修饰问题或程序、表示“法律上的”的形容词。

lexical_uses.context: Describing an action carried out in accordance with law.

explanation.en: 避暑 means escaping the summer heat, typically by going somewhere cooler. It does not mean preventing heatstroke.
explanation.zh: “避暑”指到较凉快的地方躲避夏天的暑热，不是“预防中暑”的同义词。

lexical_uses.context: Going somewhere cooler to escape summer heat.

items.new: need not; do not have to

explanation.en: 无须 says that an action or condition is unnecessary: it need not happen or be done. It does not say that an outcome is uncertain.
explanation.zh: “无须”表示没有必要，可以不做某事或不满足某个条件，并不表示结果不确定。

lexical_uses.context: Removing a requirement, rather than expressing uncertainty.

items.old: gate; door; doorway; gateway; opening (CL:扇[shan4]); valve; switch; other door-like or gate-like structure
items.new: door; gate; classifier for subjects, courses, and skills

explanation.en: 门 also counts subjects, courses, arts and skills. Put the number and 门 before the name of the subject, course, art or skill. This classifier use is separate from a physical door or gate.
explanation.zh: “门”还可用作学科、课程、技艺的量词，用在数词和相应名词之间。这一用法不同于表示出入口的“门”。

lexical_uses.context: Counting subjects, courses, arts and skills.

explanation.en: 时段 is a period or slot of time. It can be a slot assigned to someone, but does not inherently mean a work shift.
explanation.zh: “时段”指一段时间，也可指划分或安排好的时间段，并不专指工作的班次。

lexical_uses.context: Naming a period or assigned slot of time.

explanation.en: 未来 means the future or a time yet to come. It does not specifically mean tomorrow.
explanation.zh: “未来”指将来、尚未到来的时间，并不专指明天。

lexical_uses.context: Talking about time after the present.

items.new: to exempt from; to remove; to relieve (a burden or obligation)

explanation.en: 免除 means removing a burden, charge or obligation, or exempting someone from it. It does not mean preventing illness in general.
explanation.zh: “免除”表示免去、消除某种负担、费用或责任，不是泛指预防疾病。

lexical_uses.context: Removing a charge or obligation, or exempting someone from it.

explanation.en: 国有 describes ownership by the state. It can modify state-owned property or enterprises. The English public is ambiguous here: the word identifies ownership, without itself saying that everyone may enter or use the property.
explanation.zh: “国有”表示所有权属于国家，可以修饰国家所有的财产或企业。这里说明的是所有权，并不自动表示任何人都可以进入或使用。

lexical_uses.context: Identifying property or an enterprise owned by the state.

explanation.en: 主席 names the person who presides over a meeting, committee or organization, and can occur in a formal leadership title. This entry teaches the chairperson meaning. It does not name the office of a premier or prime minister.
explanation.zh: “主席”指主持会议、委员会或组织的人，也可以出现在正式领导职务的名称中。本条介绍主持者这一含义，并不是总理职务的名称。

lexical_uses.context: Naming the chairperson who presides over a meeting or organization.

items.new: a senior; someone older or more experienced

explanation.en: 前辈 names a person of an older generation or with greater seniority or experience, often in the same field. It can respectfully refer to a living, active senior. Precursor alone does not make this person-and-seniority meaning clear.
explanation.zh: “前辈”指年辈较长或资历较深的人，常用于同一领域中比自己年长或更有经验的人，也可以尊称仍在从事相关工作的人。

lexical_uses.context: Respectfully referring to an older or more experienced person in a field.

items.new: cannot attend to; cannot take into consideration

explanation.en: 顾不得 means being unable to attend to or take something into consideration, often because other demands leave no time or attention. It can be followed by the matter or concern one cannot attend to. It does not mean being unable to change that matter.
explanation.zh: “顾不得”表示无法顾及，常因其他事情紧迫而没有时间或精力去考虑、照顾某事，后面可接无法顾及的事情。它不是“没有办法改变某事”的意思。

lexical_uses.context: Lacking the time or attention to take a matter into consideration.

items.new: to rear-end; collide with the vehicle ahead

explanation.en: 追尾 means a rear-end collision: a following vehicle hits the rear of the vehicle ahead. It does not merely mean driving too close behind another vehicle. Following too closely can cause such a collision, but the collision and the unsafe following distance are different things.
explanation.zh: “追尾”指后面的车辆撞到前面车辆的尾部，并不只是表示跟车距离太近。跟车过近可能造成追尾，但危险的跟车距离与实际发生的碰撞是两回事。

lexical_uses.context: Describing or warning against a collision with the rear of the vehicle ahead.

explanation.en: 帅哥 refers to a handsome or stylish man and is also used as a casual form of address. The word describes appearance or manner; it does not by itself say that the person has romantic success or many partners.
explanation.zh: “帅哥”指长相英俊或举止潇洒的男子，也可以用作随意的称呼。这个词描述外貌或风度，本身并不表示对方恋爱经历丰富或有许多恋爱对象。

lexical_uses.context: Describing or casually addressing a good-looking man.

items.new: joys and sorrows, partings and reunions; life’s varied experiences

explanation.en: 悲欢离合 includes joys and sorrows as well as partings and reunions. Together these refer to the varied emotional experiences of human life.
explanation.zh: “悲欢离合”包括悲伤与欢乐、离散与团聚，泛指人生中各种悲喜聚散的遭遇。

lexical_uses.context: Describing the varied joys, sorrows, separations and reunions of life.

explanation.en: Here 布 is cloth or fabric, the material used to make clothes or wrap something. The same written character also occurs in words about announcing or spreading; those other uses do not change this noun meaning.
explanation.zh: 这里的“布”指布料、织物，可用来做衣服或包裹物品。同一个字也出现在表示宣布、散布的词语中；那些用法不改变这里的名词义。

lexical_uses.context: The material used for clothing or wrapping; cottoncloth棉布 and usingcloth布 towrapsomething.

items.new: transverse; lateral; in a horizontal or sideways direction

explanation.en: 横向 describes a direction across or sideways, such as sideways movement or a horizontal arrangement. It does not by itself assert that two lines meet at a right angle.
explanation.zh: “横向”表示横的方向，可指向侧面移动或横着排列。这个词本身并不表示两条线一定成直角。

lexical_uses.context: A transverse, horizontal or sideways direction.

explanation.en: 货运 names the transport of goods. It is a transport activity, rather than the goods being moved.
explanation.zh: “货运”指运输货物的业务或过程，不是被运输的货物本身。
